The first release: a messenger inside the Minecraft chat, from 1.19.2 to 26.3.

- Chat bubbles with faces, names and times; replies, editing, deleting, reactions, @mentions, "is typing"
- Private chats with read receipts
- Stickers and emoji from the server, pictures (file, screenshot, clipboard), voice messages
- Polls, search through every chat, 40 languages
- For servers: mutes, chat-plugin and LuckPerms/Vault ranks, H2/MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL, S3 storage

See the [README](https://github.com/S1nuxoff/InGame-Messenger#readme) for everything and the
[server guide](https://github.com/S1nuxoff/InGame-Messenger/blob/main/docs/server.md) for setup.

## Download

Find your Minecraft version and loader. Players need the mod; servers need the mod (same loader as the server) or the
plugin. Fabric and Quilt also need [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
